metadata.case_name: YIU YUET CHI v. YICK KAI CHEUNG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip
source: She was found to have right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip, fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs, cerebral contusion with oedema, right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema and dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (“ACJ”).
The plaintiff also received plastic surgery for the right eyelid scar on 27 May 2003 and 7 July 2003 in St Theresa Hospital.”

injuries.description: fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs
source: She was found to have right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip, fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs, cerebral contusion with oedema, right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema and dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (“ACJ”).
Chest X-ray there revealed fracture right 4th rib.

injuries.description: cerebral contusion with oedema; thin rim of subdural blood clot and diffuse axonal injury of brain
source: She was found to have right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip, fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs, cerebral contusion with oedema, right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema and dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (“ACJ”).
The MRI revealed a thin rim of subdural blood clot and diffuse axonal injury of brain.

injuries.description: right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema; multiple foreign bodies in the eye ball
source: She was found to have right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip, fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs, cerebral contusion with oedema, right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema and dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (“ACJ”).
There were also multiple foreign bodies in the eye ball.
Exploratory surgery for the removal of foreign bodies and repair of the orbital wall with titanium mesh was performed on 28 April 2003.
injuries.icd_description: Retained foreign body following penetrating wound of orbit

injuries.description: dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (ACJ)
source: She was found to have right facial swelling with laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip, fracture of her right 2nd and 3rd ribs, cerebral contusion with oedema, right orbital wall fracture with orbital emphysema and dislocation of her right acromio-clavicular joint (“ACJ”).
The right ACJ was reduced and fixed on 5 May 2003. The screw for fixing the right ACJ was removed on 18 July 2003.

manifestations.description: laceration/wounds over her right forehead and right upper lip

treatments_received: exploratory surgery for the removal of foreign bodies and repair of the orbital wall with titanium mesh on 28 April 2003
reduction and fixation of right ACJ on 5 May 2003
removal of ACJ screw on 18 July 2003
lengthy course of physiotherapy for right shoulder
plastic surgery for the right eyelid scar on 27 May 2003 and 7 July 2003
treated conservatively for diffuse axonal injury
treatments_future: plastic surgery (limited procedure as recommended by Dr Nicolson)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA awarded/assessed)
